# Environment Variables

Every setting in the on-disk YAML configuration can also be supplied via an `AUTHPLANE_*` environment variable. Env vars are evaluated after the YAML file is loaded and override matching YAML keys, making them the recommended channel for secrets and per-environment overrides (Docker `-e`, Kubernetes `env:`, systemd `Environment=`). See the [configuration reference](./configuration.md) for the full YAML schema and the deploy guides for environment-specific examples.
